buscar_em: term, duration, validity, termination, years, months, confidentiality
regra_spectra: Confidentiality term must be maximum 2 years (24 months), counted from signature or termination of negotiations. Ideal: 1 year (12 months).
como_corrigir: Change to: 'The parties shall protect the Confidential Information for a period of 24 (twenty-four) months, counted from the date of signature of this Agreement.'

buscar_em: exceptions, exclusions, shall not apply, shall not constitute, confidential information, public domain
regra_spectra: Must include ALL 4 mandatory exceptions: (1) publicly available information, (2) information already in possession of the party before the NDA, (3) information received from third parties in good faith without confidentiality obligation, (4) information required by CVM, regulatory authority or court order.
como_corrigir: Add or complete with: 'Confidential Information does not include: (i) publicly available information or that becomes public without breach of this Agreement; (ii) information provably already in the Party's possession before this Agreement; (iii) information received from third parties not subject to confidentiality obligation; (iv) information required by CVM, regulatory authority or court order.'

buscar_em: representatives, definitions, affiliates, advisors, consultants, external, economic group, mean
regra_spectra: Definition of 'Representatives' must be limited EXCLUSIVELY to persons DIRECTLY involved in the evaluation of this specific opportunity. Must NOT include: generic affiliates, GPs, managed funds, anyone from the economic group, or 'advisors' without additional qualification.
como_corrigir: Restrict to: 'Representatives means exclusively board members, officers and employees DIRECTLY involved in the evaluation of this specific opportunity and who have an effective need to know the Confidential Information.'

titulo: Liability without limitation to direct damages
buscar_em: indemnification, compensation, damages, losses, liability, lost profits, indirect, consequential
regra_spectra: Spectra's liability must be EXPRESSLY LIMITED to direct damages judicially proven. Must be EXCLUDED: lost profits, indirect damages, consequential damages, immaterial damages, non-quantifiable losses.
como_corrigir: Replace with: 'The Party shall be liable EXCLUSIVELY for direct damages judicially proven, arising from breach of this Agreement, expressly excluding lost profits, indirect, consequential, immaterial damages or non-quantified losses.'

buscar_em: use, benefit, profit, own, circumvention, exclusivity, prohibition, forbidden, prevented
regra_spectra: Avoid broad prohibitions on use that may operate as non-circumvention or undue exclusivity. Use of confidential information must be restricted only to the purpose of the specific transaction, BUT without blocking Spectra's legitimate business activities or permissible internal uses.
como_corrigir: Replace absolute wording such as 'in no way for its own benefit' with: 'use the Confidential Information exclusively for purposes of evaluating the Transaction, without unauthorized disclosure or reproduction, except for legitimate internal uses not related to misappropriation.'

buscar_em: exceptions, exclusions, shall not apply, independent development, independently developed
regra_spectra: In addition to the 4 standard exceptions, must include exception for information INDEPENDENTLY DEVELOPED by the Party, without use of the Confidential Information received.
como_corrigir: Add to the list of exceptions: '(v) information independently developed by the Party without access to or use of the Confidential Information provided.'

buscar_em: jurisdiction, applicable law, venue, district, competence, disputes, controversies
regra_spectra: Preference for Brazilian law and jurisdiction of São Paulo/SP, with waiver of any other jurisdiction, whenever possible in negotiation.
como_corrigir: Change to: 'The jurisdiction of the District of the Capital of the State of São Paulo is elected to resolve disputes, controversies and disputes related to or arising from this Agreement, to the exclusion of any other, however privileged it may be.'

titulo: Non-solicitation of employees without time limit
buscar_em: non-solicitation, employees, staff, workers, hiring, recruitment, non-solicitation
regra_spectra: If there is a non-solicitation clause, restrict to direct hiring of employees/collaborators for a maximum period of 1 year, with exceptions for candidates who contact spontaneously or via general advertisement.
como_corrigir: Limit to: 'For a period of 12 (twelve) months from the termination of this Agreement, the Parties shall not directly hire employees of the other Party, except those who apply spontaneously or through public selection processes.'

titulo: Personal data processing with limited scope
buscar_em: personal data, LGPD, GDPR, processing, protection, data subject, legal representatives
regra_spectra: If there is a personal data processing clause, it must cover ALL relevant data subjects (not just legal representatives), specify retention periods, clear legal bases, detailed purposes and anonymization/deletion mechanisms.
como_corrigir: Expand definition of Personal Data to include: representatives, employees, advisors and third parties. Specify retention period aligned with NDA term. Detail legal bases according to LGPD/GDPR.
